<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that breaks a C‑Br bond and forms a C‑N bond (typical SN2 alkylation).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
  "bonds_broken": ["C-Br"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
